title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina: Adapter Ligation
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit
This protocol adds the necessary reagents for the adapter ligation in the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina.
The OT-2 flashes and alerts the user to move the sample plate to an off-deck thermocycler
The sample plate is replaced post-thermocycler and 3 uL of user enzyme is added to the samples

steps.title: Add diluted adapter
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL of diluted adapter to each sample.

steps.title: Add master mix and ligase
steps.instruction: Add 31 µL of the combined master mix and ligation enzyme to each sample. If more than six columns (48 samples) are specified, split the master mix/ligation enzyme evenly between two strips on the temperature deck; the OT‑2 will alternate between the strips while dispensing.

steps.title: Transfer plate to thermocycler
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 flashes and alerts the user to move the sample plate to an off‑deck thermocycler.

steps.title: Return plate and add enzyme
steps.instruction: After the thermocycler step, replace the sample plate and add 3 µL of the user‑provided enzyme to each sample.
